components.name: Input
components.description: Native text field with responsive type, focus, invalid, and disabled states. Workspace URL uses these field states in one input group with a fixed current-host prefix and an editable slug; suggestions stop after manual edits, and validation retains entered values.
components.css: .ds-input { height:32px; width:100%; min-width:0; padding:4px 10px; border:1px solid var(--input, #d5d5dc); border-radius:var(--radius,6px); background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, #24242b); font-family:"Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size:16px; line-height:24px; caret-color:var(--primary, #5555ca); transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted-foreground, #676773); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--input, #d5d5dc); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring, #5555ca); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring, #5555ca) 50%,transparent); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:var(--destructive, #c0333c); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive, #c0333c) 20%,transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input, #d5d5dc) 50%,transparent); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-input { background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input, #d5d5dc) 30%,transparent); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-input:disabled { background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input, #d5d5dc) 80%,transparent); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive, #c0333c) 50%,transparent); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive, #c0333c) 40%,transparent); } @media(min-width:768px) { .ds-input { font-size:14px; line-height:20px; } } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-input { min-height:44px; } }

components.css: .ds-nav { width:216px; padding:8px; background:var(--sidebar, #f7f7f8); color:var(--sidebar-foreground, #45454f); font-family:"Geist Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-nav-row { display:flex; align-items:center; height:32px; padding:8px; gap:8px; border-radius:calc(var(--radius,6px)*.8); color:inherit; text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; line-height:20px; font-weight:400; transition:width 150ms,height 150ms,padding 150ms; } .ds-nav-row:hover,.ds-nav-row:active,.ds-nav-row[aria-current="page"] { background:var(--sidebar-accent, #eaeaec); color:var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #24242b); } .ds-nav-row[aria-current="page"] { font-weight:500; } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ring, #5555ca); } @media(max-width:767px) { .ds-nav-row { min-height:44px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nav-row { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Convex uses the Linear-inspired workspace convention chosen by the user: quiet white or charcoal surfaces, restrained indigo actions, fine dividers, Geist, and compact shadcn Nova controls. The workspace name leads navigation; the current task has a clear heading and a predictable reading order.

The interface is code-led. It uses SVG icons and initials rather than shipping decorative raster imagery. System light and dark themes retain the same spacing and hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Compact navigation with generous task spacing.
Neutral surfaces; indigo actions and focus.
Small corners, fine borders, and restrained menu elevation.
System themes, keyboard access, and responsive touch targets.

rules.name: Semantic Surface
rules.body: Use the existing semantic CSS variables so backgrounds, text, borders, and interactive states change together with system preference.

rules.name: Shared Type
rules.body: Use Geist for headings, prose, and controls; establish hierarchy with size, weight, and spacing.

rules.name: Flat Task Surface
rules.body: Keep task content and sidebar flat; reserve elevation for menus and the mobile drawer.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables for both system themes.
Do keep the current workspace at the top of the sidebar and show the current choice in the switcher.
Do preserve keyboard focus, form validation, pending states, and disabled controls.
Do expand mobile navigation and menu rows to the implemented touch targets.
Do honor reduced motion for sidebar, menu, drawer, and loading transitions.
donts: Don't replace the shadcn Sidebar and menu behavior with custom static imitations.
Don't add decorative raster assets to this code-led shell.
Don't invent issue features or navigation destinations beyond implemented functionality.
